name: Reinosa (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, red and blue crossed by a white vertical stripe of double width, charged at its centre with the crowned arms of Reinosa (a horse, a tower and a rose).
history: The flag is described as three horizontal bands of equal width, blue above and below and red in the centre, crossed vertically by a white stripe of double thickness at whose geometric centre the arms of the city are placed.

features.role: Reinosa arms — horse, tower and rose
